safety.title: Flood Safety Steps
steps: Follow official warnings from PMD, NDMA/PDMA and Rescue 1122.
Move to higher ground early. Do not wait for water to reach your home.
Never walk or drive through flood water. Even 15 cm of moving water can knock a person down.
Switch off electricity and gas before you leave home.
Keep an emergency bag ready: water, medicines, ID cards, phone charger and a torch.
safety.reviewNote: Urdu text to be checked by a fluent reviewer before the final demo.
safety.intro: Read these before the rains, not during them. Each step takes a minute and can keep your family safe.
safety.depthIntro: Moving water is far stronger than it looks. Depth is hard to judge, and roads under water may be washed away.
safety.d15: Can knock an adult off their feet
safety.d30: Can float and carry away a small car
safety.d60: Can sweep away most vehicles, including SUVs and trucks
safety.turnAround: If water is moving across a road, turn around. Do not try to cross it.
safety.depthSource: Figures from the US National Weather Service ("Turn Around Don’t Drown").
safety.emergencyText: Rescue 1122 is the emergency service. Call when a life is in danger or you are trapped by water.
